_README: THE GATE LOCK. sha256 of every gate script; scripts/gate-lock.js refuses any drift (gate zero of ratchet-battery, pre-commit, CI). Relock only through `node scripts/gate-lock.js --relock --reason "<why>"` — the act is appended to `history` below, which ledger-append-ratchet keeps append-only. Anchor `digest` on the Witness with REMEMBRANCE-BLOCKCHAIN/scripts/anchor-gate-lock.js.

history.reason: gate law installed: every ratchet's --save-baseline refuses to loosen (scripts/lib/ratchet-law.js), gate-lock added as gate zero, atomic-drift added to the pre-commit hook, console-ratchet gained the unparseable guard
covenant-ratchet save path: compare against effectiveBaseline().bs (the floor object), so a run above the floor is refused as DEBT

gate law + lock files gate their own writes through requireGate/createGate instead of an @oracle-infrastructure exemption (exemption surface held at 257); atomic identities set to the extractor's measurement

the change coin: lock the one door (goggles run.mjs, change-coin.py minter/verifier, goggles-bash-hook) and govern coins.ledger.json as append-only; gate-lock.js and ledger-append-ratchet.js list them

change-coin: the coin is saved onto the chain at mint and unfolded only when needed (--do mint unfold / verify --deep); no fractal token on mint; coin_id binds diff | seal | shape_sha256; CHANGE_COIN_NO_CHAIN for test coins
goggles: --do gate <name> — one gate in full through the surface (the battery prints one line per gate; the items behind a ✗ were only reachable by running the ratchet by hand)
goggles: --do token — layer two through the surface (the coherency token for a pattern: components, gates, chain)
goggles: --do whiten — the one resonance space fitted through the surface; the fit decomposed out of the core module
contracts gate: every falsifiable contract a ratchet (scripts/contracts-ratchet.js, --do gate contracts); the goggles surface names it
engine-entanglement and traps-ledger gates join the family; --do traps and --do field checkpoint verbs; every src declaration synced to its computed identity (automatic atomic growth)
width gate: ONE representation — no consumer reads anything but the 232-D fractal decoder (census 0, shrink-only); 41 sites swept across hub, Void and Interface

width gate widened: the 29-D L1 carried alone, the 128-point byte resample and a ==256 guard are consumers; ONE representation across field-memory, field-tool, void-library, the bug corpus and the resonance detector

width gate: the L1 boundary is drawn by the form; the shape reading is recorded on every hit (--shape, shapeAt) and never decides — measured 5/9 on labelled holdouts; the decoder-layer allowlist was inert and is gone; trap 52 recorded
Owner-approved covenant-gated denial logging for PR #355 review repair
Owner-approved atomic declarations, shell-free Git inspection, and isolated-test annotations for PR #355 gate repair
Owner-approved shell-free atomic census and covenant-gated test fixtures for PR #355 gate repair

witness-mode coin (a coin never teaches the library, 2026-09-16 ruling): change-coin.py mints and verifies with --witness; run.mjs and the bash hook carried the wall sync of the same round. Relocked by the covenant-holder's session after the ruling.

silent-catch naming inside the wall: the bash hook's three bare swallows now record through quiet() (stdin, parse, fault-write); control flow and fail-closed behavior unchanged. Same round as the witness-mode relock.

the gates ride every mint: run.mjs prints the ratchet battery's verdict (every red gate + the DEBT line) after each coin — the operator's standing ask that traps, gates and contracts load automatically on use. Report, never a block.
the gates-on-mint wiring reads the battery's verdict off the nonzero exit too (an open gate exits the battery nonzero; the first cut dropped that output). Same ask, same round.

exec verb learns sh: a git-tracked .sh runs under sh instead of being handed to python3 (ecosystem-boot.sh, the one-surface deploy boot, died on line one without this). Same round as the railway one-surface build.

the plateau applied to the gates themselves: the mint-time battery verdict is a remembered reading keyed on the hub+Void tree state, re-run only when a tree moved — the first cut re-ran the full battery on every mint, minutes per coin, the recalculation the ruling forbids. Also the boot skips a baked repo without .git instead of failing the clone into it.

the coin rule's birthday becomes explicit: since_epoch honors a tracked .coin-epoch marker (first token = the last pre-epoch commit), so moving the epoch is a committed, witnessed act instead of a history rewrite. Void's marker sits at merge 96a22a87, covering the trailerless a814cd0db3 and the three foreign-key seals its side branch carried. The operator's ruling, 2026-09-19.

the remembered gate verdict's key gains the contracts-latest digest: a refreshed contracts run must re-key the battery, or a remembered STALE row outlives its cure (measured on this mint: contracts 67/67 fresh, the memory still repeating the stale row)
exec's .sh dispatch runs bash, not dash: setup-ecosystem.sh (set -o pipefail) died under sh; bash executes POSIX sh scripts unchanged, so nothing narrows

the covenant gate refuses stale evidence: a missing or pre-change cathedral-latest.json is regenerated in-gate before ruling, and a failed regeneration fails CLOSED — the battery once printed ✓ from a pre-change diagnostic (+25 findings invisible); the trap ledger's stale-artifact lesson now lives inside the gate itself

the mint's remembered-verdict key becomes content-sensitive: git status --porcelain shows M for a modified file whether its content changed once or twenty times, so the cache served a stale ✓ over a freshly re-edited trap-guard-hook.js after silent-catch was fixed; the key now hashes git diff HEAD alongside porcelain so every real edit moves it
